segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Likewise, the Chair would like to acknowledge the presence of our Senate President for joining.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: I'd just like to give my opening statement. Good afternoon,

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Executive Secretary Ralph Recto, of course, our PMS Head, Secretary Elaine Masukat, officials and staff of the Office of the President and the Presidential Management Staff, and to my esteemed colleagues in the Senate.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: We are here today to tackle the...

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Proposed Fiscal Year 2027 Budget of the Office of the President and the Presidential Management Staff.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: The Office of the President sits at the center of the executive branch.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: It provides direction across the government and ensures that the priorities of the administration translates into concrete programs and tangible results to our people.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Meanwhile, the Presidential Management Staff supports the President by monitoring these priorities and coordinating with other departments and agencies.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Given these important responsibilities of these offices, we want to ensure that the resources we provide are put to good use.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Whether it's allocated to a frontline social service agency or to the highest office in the land, we will ensure that all items allocated are properly executed and spent strictly for the public good.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: At the same time, we recognize the longstanding tradition of inter-parliamentary courtesy according to the Office of the President.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: And we approach its budget with due respect for the institution and its mandate.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: With that, we look forward to a productive discussion on your proposed budget.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Before we proceed, I would like to ask our colleagues, our Senate President, for his opening statements, if any.
